title: XSUAA identity with multiple application roles is denied
runtime: SAP BTP Cloud Foundry / AppRouter / XSUAA / HANA Cloud
testCommand: Browser Control authenticated AppRouter fetch to AuthService.me(), followed by node scripts/qa/test-idts110-btp-role-alignment-receipt.mjs .tmp/idts110-btp-role-alignment-receipts.json
actualResult: With both IDTS_TESTER and IDTS_DEVELOPER present in the newly minted XSUAA token, AuthService.me() returned HTTP 403 and the safe invalid-role-assignment message. The UI showed the generic account-cannot-access page. The temporary Developer role was removed and BTP readback returned exactly IDTS_TESTER.
assertions: BTP role readback showed IDTS_TESTER plus IDTS_DEVELOPER before login.
A newly minted XSUAA session returned HTTP 403.
The response exposed no identity internals or HANA diagnostics.
No business mutation request was issued.
limitations: The temporary role combination existed only for this bounded acceptance and was rolled back immediately after HTTP readback.
